title: Pumpkin Swirl Brownies
changes_from_base: Oil-based chocolate batter marbled with spiced pumpkin and cream cheese; kept chilled.
summary: Chocolate brownies with a spiced pumpkin and cream cheese swirl.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with baking paper
heatproof bowl and small pan (or a microwave)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the tin.

steps.title: Pumpkin
steps.text: Microwave the cream cheese for 20-30 s to soften, then whisk in the pumpkin, sugar, flour and spices until smooth.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Combine the flour, baking powder and salt. Melt the chocolate with the oil, stir in the sugar, then the eggs, milk and vanilla, and fold in the dry mix.

steps.title: Marble
steps.text: Spread half the chocolate batter in the tin, spoon over half the pumpkin, then repeat. Swirl the two together with the tip of a knife.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 35-40 min, until a skewer in a chocolate area comes out with only a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool in the tin, then chill 1 h before cutting into 16. Keep refrigerated.

tips: Use plain canned pumpkin purée, not pumpkin pie filling.
Keep swirls loose for a clear pattern.
Chill before cutting for neat slices.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days.
